actual_checks: Full exact prompt, all source/provenance files, report and full prior announcement read. The latter is not accepted as a proved all-group formula. Report supplies the exact sharp published abelian p-group criterion in compact p-local genuine spectra, and only sufficiency is separately asserted for ordinary finite genuine spectra.

For finite p-local spectra, K(a-1)-acyclicity is type>=a, so the implication is precisely P(H,m+1) subset P(G,n+1). Substitution into source Theorem 2.3 gives m+1>=n+1+rank_p(G/H), hence m>=n+r, including m or n=0 with K(0)=HQ. H=G has r=0 and the same formula.

G abelian makes every H normal, so the quotient and its p-rank are defined. A cyclic quotient of order p^s has rank one, whereas elementary abelian rank-s has loss s. Sharpness is imported from finite partition-complex witnesses; it is not inferred merely from the upper bound or numerical experiments.

Ordinary finite G-spectra become compact p-local spectra; geometric fixed points and relevant Morava theories commute with this localization, proving sufficiency there. The report carefully confines cited necessity witnesses to the p-local category and does not assert unsupported descent to integral finite objects or arbitrary nonabelian groups.
